_doc: T-022 sourced landmark prisms (R-020 §1 rows 1-3, §2 schema). height_above_base_m is above the owning OSM structure's baked base. Rows whose sourced top does not exceed the baked building top by more than tol_height_m are NOT emitted (recorded as already right in the manifest). Bridge rows 4-7 are T-023 (bridge key, config/ggb.json); excluded items (Coit Tower, Bay Bridge, 555 California, ...) stay excluded (R-020 §1).

ctbuh.attribution: Facts cited from the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat (CTBUH) Skyscraper Center; no CTBUH data or images redistributed

port_sf_habs.attribution: Port of San Francisco; HABS CA-1910, Library of Congress (US public record)
port_sf_habs.item: R-020 ref [7] (Ferry Building clock tower 235 ft)

ggbhtd.attribution: Facts cited from the Golden Gate Bridge, Highway and Transportation District (GGBHTD) fact sheets; no GGBHTD data or images redistributed
ggbhtd.item: R-020 refs [1], [2] (tower, span, deck, cable, leg-base facts)

lidar_3dep.attribution: USGS 3D Elevation Program lidar (CA_SanFrancisco_1_B23, ARRA-CA_GoldenGate_2010); first-return max per 1 m cell, measured by measure_ggb.py
lidar_3dep.item: Golden Gate Bridge tower legs, deck and cable profile (evidence/T-023/ggb_lidar_measure.json)

bridge._doc: T-023 (R-020 §3). Geometry measured from lidar lives in config/ggb.json (measure_ggb.py). Tower top = sourced 229.18 m NAVD88 when the measured top agrees within tower_top_tol_m, else measured. Base -20 m is an Assumed sea-floor envelope. Footprint = measured leg extent, at least the sourced 10.1 x 16.5 m (across x along the axis).
